about: Long Day at the Factory is an edit of a brown tabby cat with a little gray necktie drawn on, sitting stiffly in a doorway, pasted in front of a hazy industrial plant with tall smokestacks. A blank white sign floats on the left edge, meant to name the "factory" the cat works at. The cat stares at the camera with the flat, drained face of someone who just clocked out after a double shift. The meme pretends that whatever tiny, silly task you did all day was grueling industrial labor, from the factory that makes excuses to the factory that turns coffee into slides.
origin: The template is a fan-made edit combining a photo of a cat in a tie with a photo of a power station, shared on meme sites around 2025.
usage:
The first box is the top caption. Describe the cat getting home from work, such as "me after 8 hours at the" or "dad coming home from the". The second box goes on the white sign beside the cat and names the factory, written like an industrial plant: "excuse factory", "bug factory", "overthinking factory".

The best factories make something intangible or ridiculous. The flatter and more official you make the sign sound, the funnier the exhausted cat in a tie looks.
